post.summary: POST definition for requesting a password reset
post.description:
This method defines the handler for the POST request of the request new user password script. It returns no message body and thus no contents. In contrast, it returns the HTTP status code 204.


Description:

If the user desires to change his/her password, the reset password request is triggered. The user provides his e-mail address. If the address is valid, the corresponding user ID will be encoded in a JWT token. The generated token will be stuffed into a link which directs the user to a web page where he can enter the new password. That's the starting point for the reset of the password.


Request headers:

  • Authorization: Bearer token in the format "Bearer XXXX"


Request payload:

  • user_id (str): e-mail address of the user

  • password (str): new password of the user


Result:

The result of the POST request does not contain any object or message in the response body. The HTTP status signalise the result of the submitted request. Any other response status code than 204, indicates an error during the execution.
